recipes.name: Non spicy soybean sprout soup (An-maeun kongnamulguk: 안매운 콩나물국)
ingredients: 1½ teaspoon kosher salt (or more or less to your taste)
instructions: Rinse and drain a package of soybean sprouts a few times over.
Put the soybean sprouts into a pot and add water.
Add salt, onion, kelp, and garlic. Cover and cook for about 15 minutes over medium high heat. If the soup is boiling over, open and stir it with a spoon, and crack the lid.
Lower the heat to medium and cook another 20 minutes.
Take the kelp out of the soup and stir in green onion and sesame oil.
Remove from the heat and ladle into individual soup bowls, top each serving with sesame seeds powder. Serve with rice, kimchi, and a few more side dishes.
